nodes.title: Generate title-backdrop
widgets_values: A polished 1990s arcade fighting game title backdrop: a fictional quiet suburban backyard at dusk, warm floodlights illuminating weathered timber fences, a grill and workbench. Moody charcoal and slate navy shadows, muted brick red and warm ivory, small burnished brass highlights. Hand-painted cel animation, sharp chunky brush ink, subtle paper grain, deep layered perspective. Broad dark clear central space for a large title and menu. No people, fighters, lettering, logos, interface, rays, radial speed lines, neon glow or border.

Create original 1990s hand-drawn arcade fighting game artwork, with strong ink and flat cel colors. Invented designs only, no real people, existing franchise imagery, brand marks, watermark or tiny text.

nodes.title: Generate title-logo
widgets_values: Design a single isolated arcade fighting game wordmark. Write exactly COMFY FIGHTER Z, no other text, every letter spelled exactly; huge bold ivory condensed italic capitals, oversize Z in deep brick red, thick black ink contour and slim aged brass keyline, dynamic modest angle, late 1990s screen-printed video-game logo. Entire logo centered with generous empty padding, isolated on a perfectly uniform flat chroma green RGB(0,255,0) background. No characters, scenery, frames, extra letters, subtitle, branding, watermark or light bloom.
